features: [BEGINNER-FRIENDLY DAILY RETINAL] Skip the painful 'retinol purge' and irritation. With a verified skin irritation Index of 0.00, this ultra-gentle formula is meant for daily, day-and-night use. It safely delivers powerful youth-boosting care for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

[FASTER, STRONGER, SMARTER] Formulated with advanced Retinal, this booster works significantly faster and more effectively than traditional retinol. [PERFECT SYNERGY ROUTINE] Multiply your skincare results. Start with the Hyaluronic Acid First Serum for deep inner hydration, follow with Retinal Serum to boost skin vitality, and finish with the Squalane Moisturizer for a perfect moisture lock.

[SUITABLE FOR ALL SKIN TYPES] Formulated with gentle ingredients, suitable for a variety of skin types, including sensitive skin. Backed by clinical testing for safety and efficacy, you can trust this formula for your daily skincare routine with complete confidence.
